issues.description: 10,085 duplicate (PULocationID, time_bucket) rows across 5 zones — demand predictions will be inflated ~2x for those zones
353 rows with negative trip_count (min=-5) — negative trip counts are physically impossible
311 rows with trip_count > 5000 (max=99999, baseline max=18) — corrupts LightGBM feature scaling and target distribution
142,752 rows (2.26% of dataset) have is_holiday=1 on non-holiday dates — holiday surge pricing logic fires on normal commuter demand
